title: ID0381515-DC/Si-D/BE-[HqVdSS]- Black HMI
description:
Reported behavior/issue:
Black HMI
Root cause:
Seems that the screen was defective
Solution:
Screen is replaced
On DAMEX Sanctioned List: Siemens Employee
Warranty Status: Active

power supply to screen, is 24V. Also check the HDMI cable seems
fine. I also connected the screen to my laptop but also here is stays
black. Screen had a screen update.
